title: Field Sales Executive - Sonepat
description:
****Rentokil PCI****
*Rentokil PCI is the leading pest control service provider in India. A Rentokil Initial brand, Rentokil PCI was formed in 2017 through a joint venture (JV) between Pest Control India, the number one pest control company in India, and Rentokil, the world's leading pest control brand. Rentokil PCI aims to set new standards for customer service with operations across 250 locations in India. The JV brand also focuses on developing industry\-leading service operations through the sharing of best practices, new innovations and the use of digital technologies.*
**Your Day To Day Responsibilities Will Include**
* To identify, source and secure both long term and short\-term pest control \& prevention business opportunities.
* To develop new business opportunities within current and new customer bases in accordance with the sales strategy.
* To look after client retention by ensuring customers' ongoing expectations is met.
* To manage day to day sales activities, including proposal, service agreement, and prospecting and market development.
* To support the service team by providing customer feedback.
* To develop good client relationships.
* To provide reports as per the requirement.
* To assist with debt collection


**Requirements**
**Do you have what it takes? If you want to be considered for this role you will need:**
* Graduate or MBA Fresher with Good sales knowledge and communication skills
* Good Interpersonal \& Networking Skills
* Ability to communicate effectively
* Ability to negotiate with the clients


**Benefits**
**Are you interested? Here's what you can expect when you join us**
 Attractive Base Salary
   

  

 Annual Performance Based Bonus
   

  

 Group Mediclaim Insurance Policy
   

  

 Travel Reimbursement
   

  

**Equal Opportunities**
 Rentokil Initial believes in supporting all employees to provide equal opportunities and avoid discrimination. We also place emphasis on workplace diversity which means that we are serious about creating an inclusive environment that accepts each individual's differences, embraces their strengths and provides opportunities for all colleagues to achieve their full potential.

title: International Sales Specialist
description:
**Company Description** 
 P.K.Overseas Pvt Ltd is a New Delhi–based company located in Delhi, India, serving customers across international markets. The organization focuses on building long\-term global business relationships through reliable products and services. Team members collaborate across departments to support international operations and client needs. The company values professionalism, integrity, and a commitment to responsive customer support, offering opportunities for growth in international trade and business development.
 



**Role Description** 
 The International Sales Specialist will manage and grow international client accounts, identify new business opportunities in global markets, and support the end\-to\-end sales cycle. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include generating leads, conducting market research, preparing proposals and quotations, negotiating terms, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely order processing and delivery. The role involves maintaining regular communication with international clients, addressing inquiries, and providing post\-sales support to strengthen customer relationships. This is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Sonipat, requiring close collaboration with sales, operations, and logistics teams to meet sales targets and ensure customer satisfaction.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong International Sales skills, with experience in lead generation, negotiation, and closing deals in global markets.
* Excellent Communication abilities, including clear verbal and written communication and confident client interaction.
* Knowledge of International Trade practices, export procedures, and global market dynamics.
* Understanding of International Business concepts, including pricing, contracts, and cross\-border regulations.
* Customer Service skills focused on responsiveness, problem\-solving, and long\-term relationship management.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, International Trade, Marketing, or a related field preferred.
* Proficiency in MS Office and basic CRM tools; comfort working with data and sales reports.
* Ability to work on\-site in Sonipat, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Familiarity with export documentation and logistics coordination is an advantage.
* Additional language proficiency beyond English is a plus for communication with international clients.

title: Sales & Account Manager
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE:** 




  





**We are looking for an experienced and highly proactive Sales \& Key Account Management professional to manage and grow our existing customer base while developing new business opportunities.** 




**The selected candidate will work closely with the Director and gradually take ownership of day\-to\-day customer management, including enquiries, quotations, follow\-ups, order coordination, commercial discussions and relationship management.** 




**This is a key customer\-facing role for someone who understands B2B sales in the automotive components or manufacturing industry and can independently manage customer relationships.** 




  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** 




  




* Manage and maintain relationships with existing domestic and international customers.
* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned customer accounts.
* Handle customer enquiries, RFQs, quotations and commercial follow\-ups.
* Ensure timely follow\-up on quotations and convert opportunities into orders.
* Conduct regular communication with customers to understand requirements, forecasts and upcoming business opportunities.
* Build strong long\-term relationships with customers and improve customer retention.



  





**REPORTING \& CRM:** 




  




* Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, enquiries, quotations and orders.
* Prepare regular sales reports, opportunity pipelines and customer status reports.
* Monitor pending quotations and ensure systematic follow\-up.
* Provide management with market feedback, competitor information and business opportunities.



  





**CANDIDATE PROFILE:** 




  




* **Experience:** 
 4\-9 years in B2B Sales, Key Account Management or Business Development.
* Experience in
 **automotive components, rubber products, sealing systems or manufacturing** 
 will be preferred.
* Strong experience handling customers, RFQs, quotations and commercial negotiations.
* Excellent communication and relationship management skills.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Comfortable working with Excel, ERP/CRM systems and sales reporting.



  





**EDUCATION:** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing or a related field.
* MBA in Sales/Marketing will be an added advantage.
